prost-log-message.contract: A source or replica message decodes against the whole supplied buffer. Valid unknown fields are consumed, malformed fields fail, and an encoder-produced message round-trips within the supported nesting depth.

prost-journal-record.contract: The supplied journal body is consumed as one generated Record. An encoder-produced Record decodes to its original fields, including the certified publication mode and kind, within the supported nesting depth.

prost-replay-payload.contract: On successful oversized payload unwrapping, the typed body is the whole replica protobuf frame's decoded body at the proxy's term and sequence. Runtime digest and envelope checks may reject a fetch before any dependency set is returned.

sha256-detached-replica.contract: The comparison returns true exactly when the expected bytes equal the SHA-256 digest of the complete fetched byte slice. The verifier treats SHA-256 as a deterministic function.
